stories.story_fr: ACCIONA accelere son developpement dans les energies renouvelables avec une capacite installee en croissance, confirmant son positionnement comme acteur majeur de la transition energetique en Espagne et a l'international.
stories.story_en: ACCIONA accelerates renewable energy development with growing installed capacity, confirming its position as a key player in the energy transition in Spain and internationally.

stories.story_fr: Le groupe diversifie ses revenus entre infrastructure, eau, transport et immobilier, reduisant sa dependance a un seul segment et renforçant la resilience de son modele face aux cycles economiques.
stories.story_en: The group diversifies revenues across infrastructure, water, transport and real estate, reducing dependence on any single segment and strengthening resilience against economic cycles.

stories.story_fr: ACCIONA publie des rapports integres annuels et des rapports de durabilite semestriels, signalant un engagement ESG structurel qui attire des investisseurs institutionnels orientes vers la finance durable.
stories.story_en: ACCIONA publishes annual integrated reports and semi-annual sustainability reports, signaling structural ESG commitment that attracts institutional investors oriented toward sustainable finance.
